title: ticket template: fix verified / closure request (template_version 2)
description: Closure (owner, 2026-11-04). action resolve: the FIXER moves their own ticket to RESOLVED - PENDING VERIFICATION and the approver list is tapped ("ready to close, please verify"); no review needed. action verify: closed-verified ONLY by (a) the kit's rescan that no longer reports it -- on the branch mapped to the ticket's environment; a clean scan on another branch records "fix observed on <branch>" -- or (b) a finalized review whose concurrer is NOT the fixer (a fixer verifying their own fix stays pending, never final). action reject: the verifier sends it back and it reopens. An unverified pending ticket is reminded after 7 days and escalated after 14. KDEC-037.

receipt.description: A custody receipt for the evidence (a store's object id or signature).
